title: Indemnity surcharge simulator and legal decision circuit for rapid approvals
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: Build an internal simulator and approval decision circuit that links liability/indemnity concessions (MSA/DPA) to a dynamic pricing surcharge and an automated triage path. Goal is to reduce legal review time for routine concessions by enabling Sales to surface a recommended surcharge, estimate revenue impact, and auto-route low-risk exceptions for fast-approve while flagging high-risk deals for full legal review. The feature combines a cost simulator, a decision ledger (audit trail), a small sales UI flow, and backend scoring heuristics that map clause deviations to indemnity band and recommended surcharge. This ticket covers PM work: experiment design, stakeholder alignment (Legal, Sales, Finance, Security), acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for a closed pilot with 3 sales reps.
acceptance_criteria: Closed pilot with 3 sales reps using the simulator for new enterprise quotes
Simulator shows estimated monthly revenue delta for suggested surcharge and flags deals where surcharge would not offset estimated risk
Automated triage rules successfully route >=60% of pilot exceptions to fast-approve path without manual legal review
Audit ledger persists every suggestion and final decision with links to contract artifacts (PR/Drive/Confluence)
Telemetry captured: time-to-approve, legal review load, avg surcharge applied, and win-rate delta
updates: 2025-02-14: Ticket created after cross-functional kickoff; scope agreed with Legal and Sales leadership.
2025-02-17: Initial scoring heuristics drafted by PM; baseline indemnity bands mapped to surcharge ranges (0.5% - 5% ARR).
2025-02-19: Security flagged KMS requirement for storing ledger entries; added dependency for security integration (see links).
2025-02-22: Design reviewed low-fidelity sales UI mockups; Sales requested quick estimate CTA and copy variations.
2025-02-25: Legal requested ability to set per-customer policy overrides; added to acceptance criteria and follow-up work.
2025-02-28: Technology feasibility confirmed with infra; estimate set to 5 points. Next step: engineering discovery spike and legal sign-off on triage thresholds.
notes: We are intentionally treating the surcharge as a configurable line item that Sales can present as an explicit commercial concession. The pilot will allow Legal to tune triage thresholds and Finance to validate the pricing model. If the pilot proves effective, follow-on work will extend the decision circuit to autosuggest alternative mitigations (e.g., escrow, limited-data exceptions) and wire into the billing system.
next_steps: Run engineering discovery spike to validate ledger schema and KMS integration (owner: ENG)
Legal to approve initial triage thresholds and create a whitelist for auto-approve customers
Design to produce high-fidelity CTA and microcopy for sales flow
Schedule pilot kickoff with 3 sales reps and set telemetry dashboards
